query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending')::int4 as "pending!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')::int4 as "completed!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::int4 as "failed!",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outdated = TRUE)::int4 as "outdated!"
            FROM captures
